title: The Warbler W for Duplicating an Argument
description: Define the Warbler combinator W = lambda f: lambda x: f(x)(x) to feed a single argument twice into a curried two-argument function.

steps.description: Define the Warbler W = lambda f: lambda x: f(x)(x), which passes x twice into a curried two-argument function f.

steps.question: What does W(add)(5) compute when add = lambda x: lambda y: x + y?

steps.description: Define double_via_W = W(add) and print double_via_W(5) and double_via_W(7) to get 10 and 14.
Apply W to the curried equality function eq so W(eq)(5) evaluates eq(5)(5) = True.
Trace double_via_W(5) to see W pass 5 into both slots of add.
